user.title: Observe your heating
user.description: Select the room thermostats to observe. This version only reads data; existing heating controls continue to operate.

room.title: Configure {room}
room.description: Select observation sources. These do not change thermostat or comfort-control inputs. Current control air source: {control_source}.

system.title: System observations
system.description: All observation inputs are optional and do not change control sources. Select measured flow/return temperatures. For DHW, use a resolved signal such as Boiler Flow Control DHW Active. Unknown activity remains unknown.

data_description.analytics_enabled: Collect private history and backfill from Recorder. Coverage must reach 80% before window-wide comfort and duty metrics are shown.
data_description.survey_directory: Directory containing house.yaml and rooms/*.yaml, relative to your Home Assistant config directory or an absolute path inside it. Files are read only.
data_description.history_state_policy: Recorded state availability holds unchanged available values during clean Recorder runs. Recent-change coverage is reported separately; it does not prove physical sample freshness. Choose recent changes for the previous conservative expiry policy.
data_description.journal_enabled: Record controller decisions, commands, readbacks, manual changes and notes as private events. Counts and status only appear in diagnostics.

survey_rooms.title: Survey mapping: {room}
survey_rooms.description: Choose the surveyed room for {thermostat}. A matching climate binding is suggested when unique; confirm it here. Leave unmonitored or ambiguous rooms unmapped. Survey warnings: {warnings}; details are available in Get house model.

error.invalid_source: Choose a valid source outside this integration.
error.invalid_survey: Cannot load this survey. Check its path, YAML format, room IDs and numeric values. Files must be inside the Home Assistant configuration directory.
error.invalid_survey_mapping: Choose an existing survey room; each room can only be mapped once.
error.controlled_rooms_locked: Controlled rooms cannot be removed or rebound through observation options. Restore legacy ownership and review the control import first.

abort.already_configured: Only one heating system can be configured.

room.title: Configure {room}
room.description: Select observation sources. These do not change thermostat or comfort-control inputs. Current control air source: {control_source}.

system.title: System observations
system.description: All observation inputs are optional and do not change control sources. Select measured flow/return temperatures. For DHW, use a resolved signal such as Boiler Flow Control DHW Active. Unknown activity remains unknown.

data_description.analytics_enabled: Collect private history and backfill from Recorder. Coverage must reach 80% before window-wide comfort and duty metrics are shown.
data_description.survey_directory: Directory containing house.yaml and rooms/*.yaml, relative to your Home Assistant config directory or an absolute path inside it. Files are read only.
data_description.history_state_policy: Recorded state availability holds unchanged available values during clean Recorder runs. Recent-change coverage is reported separately; it does not prove physical sample freshness. Choose recent changes for the previous conservative expiry policy.
data_description.journal_enabled: Record controller decisions, commands, readbacks, manual changes and notes as private events. Counts and status only appear in diagnostics.

survey_rooms.title: Survey mapping: {room}
survey_rooms.description: Choose the surveyed room for {thermostat}. A matching climate binding is suggested when unique; confirm it here. Leave unmonitored or ambiguous rooms unmapped. Survey warnings: {warnings}; details are available in Get house model.

mapping.title: Observe your heating
mapping.description: Select room thermostats to observe. Thermostats already bound to comfort control must remain selected; additional observation-only rooms may be added. Observation sensors stay independent from control sensors.

control_hub.title: House and shared control sources
control_hub.description: Configure the thermal survey and shared inputs used by comfort control. These selections are independent from observation mappings. Saving remains in shadow and does not claim actuator ownership.

data_description.house_dir: Directory containing house.yaml and rooms/*.yaml. This is the control model; change observation survey mappings separately.
data_description.global_enabled: Individual room enable switches still apply.
data_description.manual_flow_temp: Used only when a trustworthy measured space-heating flow temperature is unavailable.

control_boiler.title: Boiler control sources and limits
control_boiler.description: Select the boiler setpoint actuator, measurements and safety limits. The controller remains in shadow after saving. Changing the actuator revokes ownership until Claim ownership is run again.

data_description.enabled: Disables boiler writes and calculations without removing the configuration.
data_description.efficiency_profile: Optional guidance only. British Gas 430/i natural gas: full-load reference, not measured or load-adjusted efficiency. Requires measured return temperature, burner modulation and heating-active inputs. Unknown while off, warming up or outside the model range.
data_description.manual_hold_minutes: How long an external setpoint change suspends automatic boiler writes.

control_rooms.title: Comfort control: {room}
control_rooms.description: Select this room's control inputs and limits. Observation currently measures air from {observer_source}; the control air source below is deliberately independent and changes only when you submit this form.

data_description.air_temp_sensor: Leave empty to use the survey's preferred air source, then thermostat fallbacks. This does not follow the observation sensor automatically; the control sensor reports the source actually selected.
data_description.manual_hold_minutes: How long a manual thermostat change suspends comfort writes.

advisor.title: Heating Advisor
advisor.description: Select dedicated AI Task profiles from Extended OpenAI or Anthropic with tools disabled. Provider, model and effort are inherited from each profile. Enabling a review sends selected room names, thermal survey details and heating metrics to that provider. Journal note text and raw history are excluded. Schedules are optional; weekly reviews run on Monday. Reports provide advice only. Notifications are off by default; when enabled they carry the report ID, task, profile and counts only. Choose 'Include finding titles' to add titles; evidence and report text are never sent.

data_description.notify_targets: Leave empty to use a Home Assistant persistent notification.
data_description.notify_on: Failure notifications are sent at most once per task per day; a report is never announced twice.

gateways.title: Gateway monitoring
gateways.description: Select the online/availability entities of your RAMSES gateways (for example ramses_cc *_online binary sensors). A gateway is reported unresponsive when its entity has not been on for the threshold. Leave the list empty to disable monitoring. Alerts describe the entity state only; they never claim a radio command failed.

data_description.gateway_offline_minutes: Off, unavailable, unknown or missing for at least this long raises one repairs issue per gateway. Startup waits at least this long (minimum two minutes) before alerting.
data_description.gateway_events: Fires home_heating_optimisation_gateway_unresponsive and home_heating_optimisation_gateway_recovered for your own notify automations.

energy.title: Metered energy evidence
energy.description: Select up to three cumulative meter sensors. Fuel input is boiler gas or electricity; delivered heat requires a separate heat meter. Readings are stored privately as five-minute buckets with weather and hot-water context for up to 90 days. Leave every meter empty to disable. Metering alone does not prove savings.

data.calorific_value_mj_m3: Gas calorific value (MJ/m³) for m³ meters
data.volume_correction: Gas volume correction factor for m³ meters

error.invalid_source: Choose a valid source outside this integration.
error.invalid_survey: Cannot load this survey. Check its path, YAML format, room IDs and numeric values. Files must be inside the Home Assistant configuration directory.
error.invalid_survey_mapping: Choose an existing survey room; each room can only be mapped once.
error.controlled_rooms_locked: A thermostat bound to comfort control cannot be removed or rebound here. Edit its actuator in Control configuration; additional observation-only rooms are allowed.
error.controlled_survey_locked: The active control model uses this survey directory. Edit the control survey explicitly before changing the observation survey.
error.control_required_survey: Enter the thermal survey directory used by control.
error.control_required_survey_room: Enter a survey room ID that exists in the selected control survey.
error.control_invalid_survey: The control survey cannot be loaded. Check its path, YAML and room files; it must be inside the Home Assistant configuration directory.
error.control_duplicate_room: Each controlled thermostat and survey room can only be selected once.
error.control_no_rooms: Configure at least one observed room before setting up control.
error.control_invalid_time: Enter each time as HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.
error.control_invalid_policy: Choose a supported comfort policy option.
error.control_invalid_limits: Review the control limits. Minimums must be below maximums and all values must be within the supported range.
error.control_unsupported_schema: This control configuration version cannot be edited here.
error.control_active: Return every consolidated controller to shadow before editing configuration.
error.advisor_needs_analytics: Enable historical analytics before the advisor.
error.invalid_ai_profile: Select an available Extended OpenAI or Anthropic AI Task profile with Home Assistant APIs and all tools disabled. For Extended OpenAI, set Functions to [].
error.missing_ai_profile: Select a profile for each scheduled task.
error.invalid_energy_meter: Choose sensor entities with the energy or gas device class that currently have a state.
error.duplicate_energy_meter: Each meter sensor can only be selected once.
error.missing_notify_event: Select at least one notification event, or turn notifications off.
error.invalid_notify_target: Notification services must be notify.* services.

abort.control_active: Return every consolidated controller to shadow before editing configuration.
abort.control_state_save_failed: Controller state could not be saved safely, so configuration was not changed.
abort.control_no_rooms: Configure at least one observed room before setting up control.

record_adjustment.name: Record adjustment
record_adjustment.description: Record a change you have already made. This action does not change heating settings. Notes remain in private integration storage.

note.name: Note
note.description: What changed and why (up to 500 characters).

room_id.name: Room ID
room_id.description: Optional stable room ID from get_report; omit for system-wide changes.

get_report.name: Get heating report
get_report.description: Return historical metrics, coverage, adjustment notes and recent controller context. No AI or device commands are called.

get_house_model.name: Get house model
get_house_model.description: Return the current read-only thermal survey, confidence labels and explicit room mappings. Excludes address, network details, photos and occupancy routines.

reload_house_model.name: Reload house model
reload_house_model.description: Read the configured survey files again. Invalid files make the model unavailable; measurements and existing controls continue.

run_review.name: Run heating review
run_review.description: Generate a bounded advisory report using the selected AI profile. Returns the report and its evidence.

question.name: Question
question.description: Optional question; sent to the selected provider (maximum 1000 characters).

get_advisor_reports.name: Get advisor reports
get_advisor_reports.description: Return retained reports, their follow-up conversation IDs and turn counts, and profile settings. Supply a report ID to include its full evidence.

report_id.name: Report ID
report_id.description: Optional ID from the report list.

ask_advisor_followup.name: Ask advisor follow-up
ask_advisor_followup.description: Ask one bounded question about a retained report using its saved evidence and the follow-up AI profile. Counts against the daily call limit. Returns the validated answer and conversation ID.

report_id.name: Report ID
report_id.description: ID of the retained report to ask about.

question.name: Question
question.description: Follow-up question sent to the selected provider (1-600 characters).

conversation_id.name: Conversation ID
conversation_id.description: Optional ID to continue an existing conversation about the same report (8 turns maximum).

get_advisor_followup.name: Get advisor follow-up conversation
get_advisor_followup.description: Return the full question and answer text of one retained follow-up conversation.

conversation_id.name: Conversation ID
conversation_id.description: ID from a follow-up response or the report list.

preview_control_import.name: Preview controller import
preview_control_import.description: Read legacy room, boiler and sensor mappings without changing them.

import_controls.name: Import controllers
import_controls.description: Copy existing controllers and survey into consolidated shadow control.

get_control_report.name: Get control report
get_control_report.description: Read shadow decisions and ownership diagnostics.

handover_controls.name: Hand over / claim control ownership
handover_controls.description: For imports, disable retained legacy controllers; for standalone setup, verify no legacy conflict. Then journal consolidated ownership while remaining in shadow.

rollback_controls.name: Restore legacy controllers
rollback_controls.description: Stop consolidated writes and re-enable the retained legacy controllers.

get_journal.name: Get intervention journal
get_journal.description: Return recent journal events: controller decisions, commands, readbacks, manual changes, mode changes, handovers and notes. Private note text is omitted unless requested.

kinds.name: Kinds
kinds.description: Optional event kinds to include; all kinds when omitted.

room_id.name: Room ID
room_id.description: Optional stable room ID to filter events.

include_private.name: Include private notes
include_private.description: Include household note text. Off by default.

preview_history_import.name: Preview history import
preview_history_import.description: Read the Radiator Analytics store without changing it: checksum, zones, proposed room mapping and importable, archived and skipped counts.

mapping.name: Mapping
mapping.description: Optional legacy zone to room ID overrides as a mapping of legacy climate entity ID to room ID, for example climate.study to study; a null value skips a zone.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Copy compatible Radiator Analytics observations and adjustment notes into private storage as a separate imported era. Current analysis is unchanged and the legacy file is never modified.

mapping.name: Mapping
mapping.description: Optional legacy zone to room ID overrides as a mapping of legacy climate entity ID to room ID, for example climate.study to study; a null value skips a zone.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true after reviewing the preview.

retire_legacy_store.name: Retire legacy history store
retire_legacy_store.description: Rename the Radiator Analytics store file after its content has been imported. Requires the legacy integration to be removed and an import matching the file checksum.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true to rename the file.

get_energy_report.name: Get energy report
get_energy_report.description: Return metered-energy days with coverage, weather degree hours, hot-water share, configuration eras and comparability limits. No savings figure is produced when context is insufficient.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of recent local days to include (1 to 90).

get_advisor_report_summary.name: Get advisor report summary
get_advisor_report_summary.description: Return a readable summary of one retained report (latest by default): task, time, profile, evidence references, coverage, findings, limitations and follow-up actions, plus rendered Markdown text.

report_id.name: Report ID
report_id.description: Optional ID from the report list; omit for the latest report.

decide_recommendation.name: Decide recommendation
decide_recommendation.description: Record your decision on an advisor recommendation. Accepting changes no heating setting; make any change yourself through the controls and then mark it applied.

note.name: Private note
note.description: Optional reason (up to 500 characters), kept in private storage.

defer_until.name: Defer until
defer_until.description: Optional date/time to revisit a deferred recommendation.

mark_recommendation_applied.name: Mark recommendation applied
mark_recommendation_applied.description: Record that you carried out an accepted recommendation. Optionally link the journal event of the intervention. This action changes no heating setting.

journal_event_id.name: Journal event ID
journal_event_id.description: Optional ID of the journal event recording the actual intervention.

intervention_note.name: Private intervention note
intervention_note.description: Optional description of what you changed (up to 500 characters), kept private.

evaluate_recommendation.name: Evaluate recommendation
evaluate_recommendation.description: Record the follow-up outcome for an applied recommendation over an evaluation window. Outcomes are associations, not causal proof.

outcome.name: Outcome
outcome.description: improved, no_change, worse, inconclusive or failed.

get_recommendations.name: Get recommendations
get_recommendations.description: Return retained recommendations with decision history and follow-up eligibility. Private notes are excluded unless requested.

include_private.name: Include private notes
include_private.description: Include private decision and intervention notes in the response.

propose_trial.name: Propose trial
propose_trial.description: Create a reviewable proposal to change one allowlisted tunable for a bounded time. Nothing changes until the owner approves and starts it. DHW protection, modes and enable switches are excluded.

parameter.name: Parameter
parameter.description: Room: trust_k, cap_up, cap_down. Boiler: design_flow, design_outdoor, return_ceiling.

target_value.name: Target value
target_value.description: Value to trial; must be within bounds and within max_step of the current value.

rationale.name: Rationale
rationale.description: Private reason for the trial (not exposed by default).

duration_hours.name: Duration (hours)
duration_hours.description: 1 to 168 hours; the trial rolls back automatically when this elapses.

comfort_floor_c.name: Comfort floor (°C)
comfort_floor_c.description: Optional measured room air temperature below which the trial stops and rolls back.

recommendation_id.name: Recommendation ID
recommendation_id.description: Optional retained recommendation this trial follows.

approve_trial.name: Approve trial
approve_trial.description: Explicitly approve a proposal. Requires ownership ready, the scope already active/auto with no activation blocker, and no other trial running.

reject_trial.name: Reject trial
reject_trial.description: Reject a proposed or approved trial without applying anything.

start_trial.name: Start trial
start_trial.description: Apply an approved trial value through the owning controller's tunable. No mode, DHW or actuator command is issued.

stop_trial.name: Stop trial
stop_trial.description: Roll a running trial back to its baseline now and verify the readback.

complete.name: Mark completed
complete.description: Record the stop as a planned completion rather than an early stop.

evaluate_trial.name: Evaluate trial
evaluate_trial.description: Record an outcome for an ended trial alongside its predeclared criteria and measured metrics. Outcomes are associations, not causal proof.

get_trials.name: Get trials
get_trials.description: Return retained trials with criteria, history and evaluations. Private rationale and notes are excluded unless requested.

include_private.name: Include private notes
include_private.description: Include private rationale and notes in the response.

preview_identity_migration.name: Preview identity migration
preview_identity_migration.description: List legacy output entities, whether each can keep its ID and history under consolidated control, collisions and known dashboard/automation consumers. Changes nothing.

migrate_identities.name: Migrate legacy output identities
migrate_identities.description: After handover, move compatible legacy output entity IDs (with their history and statistics) onto the consolidated entities. Incompatible metrics are archived under their legacy IDs. Requires confirm: true.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true. The integration reloads after a transfer; controls stay in shadow.

rollback_identity_migration.name: Roll back identity migration
rollback_identity_migration.description: Rename consolidated entities back and recreate the journalled legacy registry entries.

dhw_charge_problem.title: Hot-water charge needs review
dhw_charge_problem.description: The boiler controller reported: {reason}. Check the cylinder and heating system.

gateway_unresponsive.title: Heating gateway not responding
gateway_unresponsive.description: {entity} has not reported online since {since} ({minutes} minutes). Room and boiler control continue and radio schedules use the cached copy. This is the online entity's state only; it does not show that a radio command failed. Check the gateway's power, USB or network link and the ramses_cc diagnostics.

trial_rollback_failed.title: Heating trial rollback could not be verified
trial_rollback_failed.description: The {scope} trial of {parameter} could not restore its baseline value {value}. Check the control number entity and set it back manually, then stop the trial.
